title: Sensory Overload
paragraphs: Capturing my first encounter with New York City at age 12, this piece depicts a whirlwind of languages, people, and colors converging in one bustling space. Painted in acrylic for its bold, clashing yet cohesive color, the composition draws from travel postcards and the playful graphic style of Where's Wally, mirroring the eclectic energy of the city and the sense of discovery that came with experiencing it for the first time.
